voice_principles: the read of the wood carries the feeling
no emotion named that a gesture or the tide could imply
diction: boatyard vocabulary: garboard, plank, caulk, keel, frame, transom, hood end, trolley, slip
few adjectives, each earning its place
syntax: an occasional long sentence for one sustained action
rhythm: let a silence be an action, not a described feeling
imagery: wet paint, punky wood, the cold of the estuary, the creeping line of water
the surveying knife and the tide as recurring pressures
dialogue: subtext over statement; Aldous says less than he means
avoid: filter words (she felt / saw / realized / noticed / watched)
